# Scripting API

<!-- Generated by MakeScriptReference() (tools/project/luau_tooling.h) from the engine's script API; do not edit. Run the tests with SPOT_UPDATE_DOCS=1 to write it again. -->

Everything the engine gives Luau scripts. [Scripting](../guides/scripting.md) explains how scripts run; this page lists what they can reach. Properties marked *read only* cannot be assigned. Every property also has the methods older scripts use, such as `GetName()` and `SetName(value)` for `name`. Parameters in brackets are optional.

## Hooks

Functions a script defines for the engine to call, with how many parameters they take.

| Hook | Parameters |
|---|---|
| `OnStart` | 0 |
| `OnEnable` | 0 |
| `OnDisable` | 0 |
| `OnFixedUpdate` | 1 |
| `OnUpdate` | 1 |
| `OnLateUpdate` | 1 |
| `OnDestroy` | 0 |
| `OnCollisionEnter` | 1 |
| `OnCollisionStay` | 1 |
| `OnCollisionExit` | 1 |
| `OnTriggerEnter` | 1 |
| `OnTriggerExit` | 1 |
| `OnCollisionEnter2D` | 1 |
| `OnCollisionStay2D` | 1 |
| `OnCollisionExit2D` | 1 |
| `OnTriggerEnter2D` | 1 |
| `OnTriggerExit2D` | 1 |
| `OnReload` | 0 |

## Globals

Value types, built by functions of the same name.

- [`Vector2(x, y)`](#vector2)
- [`Vector3(x, y, z)`](#vector3)
- [`Color(r, g, b, a)`](#color)

## The `spot` module

What `local spot = require("@spot")` gives.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `Input` | [`Input`](#input) | read only |
| `Scene` | [`Scene`](#scene) | read only |
| `Time` | [`Time`](#time) | read only |
| `Physics` | [`Physics`](#physics) | read only |
| `entity` | [`Entity`](#entity) | read only |
| `Component` | [`Component`](#component) | read only |
